The data_i, data_o, push_i and pop_i connections had actual_type=<error>; data_o expression was null for each instance. The server returned the data_i, push_i and pop_i source expressions shown above.
evidence.diagnostic_evidence: summarize_diagnostics_by_code returned all six groups without truncation; get_diagnostics returned 58 individual diagnostics. The 40 InvalidMemberAccess errors arise at scalar AXI request/response field accesses, and the five EmptyOutputPortConn warnings occur at the five usage_o bindings. Other warnings concern axi_pkg.sv and axi_intf.sv.

limitations: The standalone top defaults all AXI channel types and request/response types to logic. Request and response member selections are invalid under those defaults, producing 40 errors. The port expressions are source bindings, not verified typed connections or evidence of a working elaboration.
For all five data_o ports the semantic server returned an error type and a null expression; their source expressions were read directly from axi_fifo.sv.
The fragment load does not verify project completeness. No parent parameter overrides, replacement wrapper, or non-default AXI types were supplied.
